chose: An episode's scenes take their copy from its walkthrough (`some-ui.walkthrough/1`, @some-ui/video-motion), the family that already holds an app's chapters, each a title and narration written as part promo and part mission (C945), over the walk's screens: the Android episode reads the Jobs walkthrough's four chapters, the server episode the home-server walkthrough's two. An episode or a scene with no chapter writes its own words in show.ts, marked draft until the owner has read them (the extensions' three scenes): a draft shows only in the owner's local preview (preview:pages sets SITE_SHOW_DRAFTS), never on Pages, and an episode with nothing else waits whole, so words the owner hasn't read never go public. The words keep to what the repo says (the extension's README and walk, AMO's unlisted channel, Page Filter's own line); the cores gap stays the gaps section's, not a scene. A still face names its walk's screen by number and must lie within its chapter's own screens, so a face always shows what its copy names; its band's label is that screen's caption. The show is a versioned, compile-time type (`some-ui.landing-show/1`); the build refuses a show that names a missing chapter, a still outside its chapter, an empty line of copy, or fewer than two episodes.
options: walkthrough chapters as the scenes' copy, the landing's own words only where no walkthrough exists
a new copy table for the landing alone
